report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; logs show INFO/ok, metrics show zero 502s and p95 ~98ms on /v1/checkout. No error, saturation, or latency anomaly is present in current evidence, so no public cause is substantiated. Handing off rather than asserting a fault.
missing_evidence: Evidence of an actual failure or latency regression (errors, elevated p95/p99, timeouts) on checkout or its dependencies
Dependency-level metrics (redis/postgres/payment) to assess redis-timeout, db-pool-exhaustion, or downstream-latency
Baseline latency for /v1/checkout to judge whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Deployment or configuration change records correlated with the alert window
